judged_text: lib/topic_retriever.rb:15 — Hostnames are compared case-sensitively even though DNS host matching is case-insensitive, rejecting otherwise valid embed URLs

record.issue_text: lib/topic_retriever.rb:15 — Hostnames are compared case-sensitively even though DNS host matching is case-insensitive, rejecting otherwise valid embed URLs

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a case-sensitivity issue in lib/topic_retriever.rb line 15: `SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host`. DNS hostnames are case-insensitive per RFC standards, but this Ruby string comparison is case-sensitive. If embeddable_host is 'EvilTrout.com' and the URL host is 'eviltrout.com', they would not match even though they refer to the same host. This is a real bug that could cause valid embed URLs to be rejected.
